title: Bookkeeping
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze and record financial transactions in a manual or computerized general ledger system.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to prepare financial statements, analyze and prepare financial information for management decision-making.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to illustrate effective communication within a business environment.
Utilize current income tax resources to prepare personal income tax returns. Assessment:Complete tax returns and exams
Process payroll transactions in accordance with current payroll reporting requirements. Assessment:Complete Practice Sets and Class Projects: Business simulations

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (e.g. 'BSADB5'); recorded as printed. Each matches the closed-list code with a space (BSAD B5, etc.), so none is a catalog addition.
The 25.5 total is printed for the certificate as '(Total 25.5)' and also equals the sum of the single 'Complete all of the following' block; recorded as the block's stated total as well.
Catalog titles differ from the state file: BSADB5 'Human Relations and People Skills' vs 'Human Relations in Business'; COMPB5 'Introduction to Microsoft Office' vs 'Introduction to Microsoft 365'.

Program Learning Outcomes are numbered oddly (1, 2, 3, 3, 5; no 4). The last two include 'Assessment:' text, copied as printed. The income-tax outcome does not correspond to any required course; it may be carried over from another program. Reviewer should check.
Careers: 'accounting profession' and 'accountants' are taken from the program description.
